items.title: Louie Bellson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Burt Porter, who was one of the guys that brought in the Ampex hi-fi, he recorded the band one night in Fresno, California.

ctx.x: I was just, you know, as a kid I couldn’t get over it. And it enjoyed some success as a jazz cut you know. And then later on we couldn’t find a studio in those days to record “Skin Deep,” because all that drumming, they couldn’t find a studio to get the clarity of all those fast beats that I was doing on “Skin Deep.” So Duke hesitated. He said “let’s wait on that one.” So while we were on the road, Burt Porter, who was one of the guys that brought in the Ampex hi-fi, he recorded the band one night in Fresno,…
So it was recorded not in the studio, or was it recorded on location or something? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -8-
